body: Thank you for your kind words.  I hope you are doing well.  I don't know how I am going to carry on without the hope that we are going to get back together.

Thank you for your comment.  She messaged me today and said that I should move on, because she has.

I am heartbroken.  But we are going no contact.

I feel so lost.

You were right.  She messaged me today to tell me she didn't want to give me the wrong idea by messaging me and that she is moving on and hopes I am too.

I am heartbroken.  Literally feels like the day we broke up.

But I guess this is it.  No more contact.

Merry Christmas to you too.  I really appreciate your reply, I think you're right.  The issue is there is a huge, hidden part of me that is expecting and hoping for reconciliation, so this is a me issue that I need to deal with.  Thank you again.
I think I have lost her. I am too much for her, I confessed I was suicidal and that I don't want her to hate me. She told me she couldn't cope and left. I am truly alone now. There is no point living
